source.name: Escape must close the dropdown menu and return focus to its toggle button

journey.title: Close the invoice actions menu with Escape
journey.goal: Escape closes the menu and focus returns to the toggle

functionalJourney.title: Archive the invoice from the actions menu
functionalJourney.goal: The chosen action runs and the menu closes

guards.title: Choose an action with the keyboard
guards.goal: Arrow keys move through items and Enter runs one

plan.root_cause: Escape key hides the dropdown menu but does not restore focus to the toggle button, leaving focus trapped inside the menu.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focus() call to the toggle element after the menu is hidden in the _completeHide method of the dropdown component.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape will close the actions menu and return focus to the Invoice actions toggle button, meeting keyboard accessibility requirements.
functional_risks: If the toggle button becomes disabled or non-focusable after the menu hides, focusing it could be ineffective or cause unexpected behavior.
Adding focus may interfere with custom focus management if the page implements its own focus routing for the dropdown.
verification_requirements: After pressing Escape, the element with id 'actions-toggle' must receive focus.
The aria-expanded attribute on #actions-toggle must be 'false'.
The dropdown menu (#actions-menu) must remain hidden (not visible).
Keyboard navigation (ArrowDown, Enter) to select menu items must continue to work as before.
